Replies.Text:
Build log: Step 5.1, The swap. Built by Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude-CLI) on 2026-10-30. Nothing is committed.

What was built, by item:

1. desktop/ took the Client's code base: desktop/main.js (the Servers list, one Clerk sign-in handed to the page, every added Server a root reached through /servers/<name>/api, Add server through src/Probe.js, rename and remove, New window on the same list, the command line --config alone with a bare argument refused), desktop/Settings.js (desktop.json: Servers, Theme, Scale, Remembered, over the base Settings; an older file's Recent and Hosts are read for the look and the remembered state alone and dropped at the next save; nothing from client.json), desktop/preload.js (the shared bridge with Edition desktop, Clerk, Servers, AddServer, RenameServer, RemoveServer; no SetLicense until Step 5.2, no folder). build/desktop.json carries desktop/**, electron/**, src/**, public/** and no guide until Step 5.3; the folder command Open in Consensus Desktop and its build/installer.nsh are gone, since the Desktop opens no folder.
2. client/ took the desktop code of before, narrowed: client/main.js (one Server and one project per window; the chooser at client/page/connect.html, connect.js, connect.css, moved from desktop/page; consensus-client [--connect <server> [<project>]] [--config <folder>] through App.Arguments with Positional true for the project, Rest false, so --port and any other flag are "not an argument the Client knows", and a bare folder is refused with the same sentence by main.js; --connect takes the saved Server's Name and the project after it, else the Server's last project, else the chooser opens on that Server's project list; connect_server_here probes the Server, finds the project by id or name among its projects, saves the Server with that project as its last and opens it, or the whole Server when it asks for a sign-in; set-license and clear-license keep the machine's current user through electron/CurrentUser.js), client/Settings.js (client.json: Servers with Project and Title, Theme, Scale, Remembered), client/Projects.js (ServerProjects, FindProject, Key; NewFolder and Normalize gone), client/preload.js (Edition client, SetLicense, ClearLicense, Project; Desktop.Settings, ServerProjects, ConnectServer, RemoveServer, NewWindow, Quit; no folder picker, no recent list). Gone with the folders: open_folder_here, New project, the recent folders, Forget, Open folder in new window, Open recent, the routing to this machine's Server (desktop/ServerStatus.js deleted) and src/Start.js. The chooser lists the saved Servers (Open its last project, Project… to pick another, Remove) and Connect to Server (Name, Url, Try, a project picked, Connect).
3. electron/Servers.js: Fill keeps an entry's Project and Title when they are strings (the Client's last project; the Desktop's entries stay { Name, Url }), AddServer carries them, and SetProject( Settings, Name, Project, Title ) sets or forgets a Server's last project.
4. The page's switch for the thin page is the bridge's Edition: roots.Desktop (roots.Client before), DESKTOP_APP in tree.js, DESKTOP in session.js, DesktopSignedOut in app.js and index.html, and the client-servers and client-runs components read Edition desktop; the Client flag of before is read nowhere and set nowhere. The components keep their names. The Sidecar flag stays as it was.
5. bin/mcp.js: --server <name> reads a saved Server from desktop.json's Servers (its Hosts list before).
6. bin/smoke.js: the Client part is the desktop part of before, narrowed (the chooser with its Servers alone, a temporary server's project opened through the bridge, the one project's page, the overlay, the menu without a folder item, About, the theme and the size, a detached window, Quit asking about a draft); the Desktop part is the Client part of before (two servers, the stand-in sign-in, no configuration, the menus, a run followed from the press, Add server, desktop.json, Quit); the DevTools helpers take the app's port. Not run here: it needs Electron with a screen and the owner's word.
7. bin/docs.js: the applications' pictures come from the Client (client-connect, client-project, client-menu, and the Server's LLM page and run as llm-page and llm-run) and the Desktop (desktop-servers, with the sign-in stood in for as the smoke does); the pictures of before are renamed to the new names in docs/images (git mv) and the pages reference them. The pictures were then made for real (node bin/docs.js screenshots, 56 written): the Client's chooser with the saved Server and its last project, the Server's project open in the Client, the Client's menu, the LLM page and a run, and the Desktop with the Server as a root; getting-started.md shows the Desktop picture.
8. The docs say the cut: docs/guide/getting-started.md rewritten (which application, the Desktop, the Client, the four installers, the account and the tiers), docs/guide/client.md rewritten for the new role, and features.md, sidecar.md, server.md, settings.md, llm.md, api.md (the view operations' descriptions in src/Operations.js), projects.md, sharing.md, editing.md, export-import.md, ways-of-working.md and docs/index.html edited where they named the desktop's old role; the guide pages rebuilt (node bin/docs.js build, 14 pages, no problem). The repo readme's present-tense parts (the usage lines, the four editions, the tiers, the installers, the Desktop section, the layout line), .guides/build-with-consensus.md, .guides/run-the-smoke.md and .definitions/sidecar-mode.md follow. The docs state the Desktop's minimum as Personal, as the cut says; the check itself is Step 5.2's.

Files: desktop/main.js, desktop/Settings.js, desktop/preload.js, desktop/package.json, desktop/ServerStatus.js (deleted), client/main.js, client/Settings.js, client/preload.js, client/package.json, client/Projects.js (from desktop/), client/page/connect.html, connect.js, connect.css (from desktop/page/), electron/Servers.js, electron/Page.js, electron/Windows.js (comments), build/desktop.json, build/installer.nsh (deleted), public/js/roots.js, session.js, tree.js, app.js, public/index.html, public/components/server-row/server-row.html, project-view/project-view.html, title-bar/title-bar.js, client-servers/client-servers.js, client-runs/client-runs.js, bin/mcp.js, bin/smoke.js, bin/docs.js, src/Operations.js, docs/guide/*.md and *.html, docs/index.html, docs/images/* (renamed), readme.md, .guides/build-with-consensus.md, .guides/run-the-smoke.md, .definitions/sidecar-mode.md, test/Desktop.test.js, test/Client.test.js, test/Scaffold.test.js, test/ReadOnly.test.js (new), test/ClerkSmoke.test.js, test/Mcp.test.js, test/Docs.test.js.

How it was checked:

- test/Desktop.test.js rewritten: desktop.json (the defaults, nothing from client.json, an older file's Recent and Hosts read for the look alone and dropped at the next save, written and read back, unreadable), the Servers functions, the app's files (the Client's code base: no Start.js, no license, no folder; the bridge's fields), the page's switch by Edition desktop in every file, the installer (no guide, no folder command), the hidden menu's template (the Desktop and the Client pass no folder action, the Sidecar does).
- test/Client.test.js rewritten: client.json (the Servers with their last project and title, nothing from desktop.json, unreadable), SetProject, the command line through App.Arguments with the Client's flags (--connect with and without the project, --config; --port, a second project and an unknown flag refused; the bare folder parsed as the positional, which main.js refuses), the chooser's work (a Server's projects listed from a temporary server, the project found by id or name, the stored key), the page server serving the page and the Client's chooser and forwarding to each root, the app's files and the installer.
- test/Scaffold.test.js: the Arguments cases follow the apps (the Desktop's line --config alone, a bare argument and --port refused; the Client's line; the Server's line alone).
- test/ReadOnly.test.js (new): the read-only server over a Server's file, which was test/Desktop.test.js's sidecar-mode test; no edition starts one since the cut, and the option stays in src/Server.js, src/Store.js and src/Users.js (a candidate for removal, not this Step's). The Clerk smoke's desktop test (a sign-in on the window's own server) is taken out, since no edition has such a window; it ran only with the Clerk keys.
- test/Docs.test.js lists the new pictures; test/Mcp.test.js names a saved Server in desktop.json's Servers.
- The dead-export check: the only unread functions are bin/docs.js Publish and electron/Servers.js UniqueName, which the Desktop test reads.
- The whole suite: 327 tests, 324 pass, 2 skipped (the Clerk keys), 1 failed under load (test/Ui.test.js "users and roles", the roles folder count, a known load flake); test/Ui.test.js alone: 48 tests, 47 pass, 1 failed ("the task buttons on the plan page", which sees the previous test's connection, the other known flake), and that test alone passes. The Docs test ran the screenshot script over a copy of docs/ with the Client and the Desktop in their new roles and every picture was written.

Decided during the build: the Registered gate before connecting (a sign-in needed before Connect to Server, made from a sidecar page) goes, since the Client has no sidecar page to sign in on: a Server takes no bare request, the person signs in on the Server's page, and the sign-in's token, verified by set-license and written as the current user, is Registered at least, which is the minimum the plan asks; the chooser's Connect to Server is enabled before any sign-in. The Client's --connect project is App.Arguments' one positional (PositionalName project), so a bare folder parses and main.js refuses it with the plan's sentence. The page's switch is the bridge's Edition rather than a renamed flag, as Step 3's thread foresaw; the client-servers and client-runs components keep their names. The Client's page shows what the person's role on the Server allows (settings, instructions for Administrators and Managers), as the desktop code did on a Server root; the Client guide says so. The docs' app pictures are renamed rather than left under the desktop's names.

Resolve to accept: I apply this thread, commit as "Review 2026-10-29 Step 5.1: The swap", set the subplan Finished and bring the Readme up to date. Reply to send it back.
